{{Top|leg}}
'''Thanik''' was a subscriber to [[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]. Thanik commented on the entry for the [[87-RM Scout Collector]], believing that the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] were responsible for reprogramming one of the [[Droid/Legends|droids]], leading to the deaths of three hundred [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]] on [[Corva Yag/Legends|Corva Yag]].<ref name="CDD">{{JournalCite|13|Cynabar's Droid Datalog (article series)}}</ref>
